units.source_text: 左大臣也意气消沉，难得入宫。

en.t: The Minister of the Left, too, was dispirited and rarely went to court.

units.source_text: 往年朱雀帝当太子时，曾经欲娶葵姬，左大臣拒绝了他，将葵姬嫁与源氏。

en.t: Years earlier, when Emperor Suzaku was still crown prince, he had wanted to marry Lady Aoi, but the Minister of the Left refused him and gave Aoi in marriage to Genji.

units.source_text: 弘徽殿母后至今不忘此事，怀恨在心。

en.t: The Kokiden Empress Mother had never forgotten this, and still nursed resentment in her heart.

units.source_text: 况且左大臣与右大臣一向不睦，加之桐壶院在世之时，左大臣独揽朝纲，任意行事。

en.t: Moreover, the Minister of the Left and the Minister of the Right had long been at odds, and while the Kiritsubo Retired Emperor was alive, the Minister of the Left had monopolized the affairs of state and acted as he pleased.

units.source_text: 如今时移世变，右大臣成了皇上的外祖父，自然得意扬扬。

en.t: Now times had changed, and the Minister of the Right had become the emperor's maternal grandfather, so he was naturally full of pride.

units.source_text: 左大臣看了意气消沉，也是当然之理。

en.t: It was only natural that the Minister of the Left should feel dejected when he saw this.
